svg.aria-label: Tesla module zones drawn directly on Sunrun's surveyed roof plan, plus the new garage addition
svg.text: Tesla modules on Sunrun's surveyed roof — existing geometry
Shaded zones = TSP-420 placement on today's roof planes, matching Sunrun's engineered arrays (base: permit sheet PV-2.0) · dashed = the NEW garage addition
A+G face 164° SSE · B 254° WSW · C 74° ENE · D+E 344° NNW — 38 modules · 16.0 kW · ≈ 19.9 MWh/yr on existing planes.
The remodel's larger gables (per the 3D renderings) may raise this toward ~45–47 modules / ≈ 27 MWh — the AMS roof plan is the decider.
